clips.title: Open-Sea Trade Wind
clips.recipe: 40 s broadband filtered noise bed shaped for steady North-Atlantic trade wind across rigging and sea surface (Storm Layer 0).

clips.title: Cutwater Bow Rush
clips.recipe: 20 s continuous hydrodynamic cutwater rush attached to the stem; scales linearly from 0 to 10 kn with slow dual-sine drift modulation.

clips.title: Stern Turbulent Wake
clips.recipe: 20 s FFT-periodic Gaussian noise shaped with 70-2200 Hz bandpass (slope 0.7, -0.15 tilt) and 0.5 Hz periodic swell modulation.

clips.title: Working Timber & Frames
clips.recipe: Heavy seasoned oak frame and plank-seam groan triggered by roll angle and wind load on square-rigged vessels (CC0 source).

clips.title: Sheltered Quay Swell Lap
clips.recipe: 30 s spatialised harbour basin water bed modulated on a 4.3 s sheltered pier-swell cadence around stone quays.

clips.title: Force-8 Gale Shroud Roar
clips.recipe: 40 s mid-high-band aerodynamic roar crossfaded smoothly across 24-36 kn apparent wind (Storm Layer 1).

clips.title: Squall Rain on Deck & Sea
clips.recipe: 30 s high-frequency droplet patter bed coupled directly to active Niagara squall precipitation density (Storm Layer 3).

clips.title: Shattered Reach — Calm Theme
clips.recipe: Low brass, cello, and maritime strings score for peaceful archipelago passages (off by default; 4 s fade-in when enabled).

clips.title: Iron & Squall — Action Theme
clips.recipe: Driving orchestral percussion and dark low-brass motif triggered on hostile naval contact with 2.5 s crossfade.

clips.title: Bow Wave Shoulder Wash
clips.recipe: 20 s FFT-periodic broadband wash (250-3000 Hz, 0.7 Hz AM) boosted dynamically by live bow submergence in swell.

clips.title: Boundary-Layer Hull Foam Hiss
clips.recipe: 20 s high-band aerated bubble hiss (900-6000 Hz, 1.0 Hz AM) along the midbody waterline above 8 kn.

clips.title: Anchor & Idle Hull Lapping
clips.recipe: Close-perspective gentle water slap against iron and timber plating when hove-to or making under 4 kn.

clips.title: Hurricane Rigging Whistle
clips.recipe: High-velocity storm wind howling through stays and funnel guys above 38-48 kn (Storm Layer 2, CC0 source).

clips.title: Harbourmaster Double Ship's Bell
clips.recipe: Procedural 1870s cast-bronze double bell chime (t=0.0 s + t=0.38 s, D5 587.3 Hz prime, 1174.7 Hz octave, 1410 Hz tierce, 2093 Hz nominal) on port mooring.

clips.title: Steam Merchant Foghorn
clips.recipe: Deep low-pressure steam whistle sounded across 9 km attenuation radius by passing merchant steamers and on contact.

clips.title: Turret & Broadside Cannon Report
clips.recipe: Heavy black-powder naval gun discharge with low-end concussion; pitch-shifted to 0.62x for armour-belt shell impacts.

clips.title: Bridge Call — Contact Bearing
clips.recipe: 19th-century bridge command call announcing hostile vessel sighting on entering detection range.

clips.title: Bridge Call — Clear for Action
clips.recipe: Follow-on bridge gunnery order sequenced automatically after initial contact report.

clips.title: Spotting Officer — Correct Elevation
clips.recipe: Rangefinder spotting callout advising fall-of-shot correction after a bracketed salvo.

clips.title: Damage Control — Hull Hit Report
clips.recipe: Watch officer damage report triggered on incoming shell impact (rate-limited to once per 25 s).

clips.title: Spotting Officer — Splash Observed
clips.recipe: Short fall-of-shot splash observation alternated with elevation correction calls.

clips.title: Close Squall Thunder (< 2.8 km)
clips.recipe: Synthesised close-strike thunder crack and low-pass rumble delayed by acoustic travel time d / 343 m/s.

clips.title: Horizon Thunder Roll (2.8 - 7 km)
clips.recipe: Low-passed 300 Hz brown-noise distant storm roll arriving 8-20 s after horizon sheet lightning.

clips.title: Heavy Hull Strain & Grounding Crunch
clips.recipe: Deep structural timber and iron-knee groan used for storm sea states >= 2.8 and pitched down 0.5x on shoal grounding.

clips.title: Brass Telegraph & Menu Detent
clips.recipe: Crisp 90 ms band-passed mechanical detent click routed to pause-safe SC_UI bus.
